# U57: The check-in is honest at its edges: it says its week and keeps “2 of 2” after a reload, last week’s story is changed or said to be still true, the newest check-in shows on the goal page, and the one-table check-in shares the draft, counts the rows that are ready and ends on the same confirmation

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `HONEST-CHECKIN`, `REASON-BEHIND`, `DRAFTS`, `BULK-EDIT`, `GOAL-PAGE-ONCE`
- **Budget:** at most 26 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Chen, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U57

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Chen has two goals due (Jenkins jobs, integration tests); Jenkins was behind last week, with a reason and a plan.
- Open a fresh browser as Chen (`chen`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- _Note:_ U16: Home's ring says what it counts (on a computer; a phone's ring sits beside the title that says it).
- If on a computer:
  - **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/check-ins/.test(await p.locator('.home-hero .ring').innerText())`. Else it says: Home’s ring doesn’t say it counts check-ins.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Start check-in / Pick up where you left off” link in Home’s lead is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Start check-in / Pick up where you left off” link in Home’s lead.
- _Note:_ U8: which week, and where in the queue, from the first screen.
- **Check:** A week in the check-in shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `` await said() === `Week ${NOW} check-in · 1 of 2` ``, where `const head = p.locator('.ci-week')`; `const said = async () => (await head.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: the header says “{said()}”.
- _Note:_ A reload keeps the queue: still "2 of 2", not a shorter queue of what's left. (Opened again by its address, the same tab: a bare reload would drop the demo's pinned day. The walk is ?start=1; /check-in alone is the week's list.)
- Go to `/check-in?start=1` in the demo.
- **Check:** A week in the check-in shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `` await said() === `Week ${NOW} check-in · 2 of 2` ``, where `const head = p.locator('.ci-week')`; `const said = async () => (await head.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: after a reload the header says “{said()}”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!now && !!was && now.why === was.why && now.pathToGreen?.what === was.pathToGreen?.what`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const was = s0.checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'dep-jenkins').sort((a, b) => a.postedAt.localeCompare(b.postedAt)).pop()`; `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `const now = s1.checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'dep-jenkins' && c.week === NOW).pop()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: the story said to be still true was not posted as it was.
- _Note:_ U11: on the goal page, the check-in just posted stands on its own, with its number and status.
- Go to `/goals/dep-jenkins` in the demo.
- **Check:** The stream ci in the stream, or the stream group in the stream (`.stream > li.stream-ci, .stream > li.stream-group`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `(await firstCi.getAttribute('class')).includes('stream-ci') && await firstCi.locator('.status-shape, .chip').count() > 0`, where `const firstCi = p.locator('.stream > li.stream-ci, .stream > li.stream-group').first()`. Else it says: the newest check-in is folded into a range.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “goal page”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ U12: the one-table check-in shares the draft with the one-by-one check-in, both ways.
- Open a fresh browser as Chen (`chen`).
- Go to `/quick-check-in` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type {a number 105% of the way from the goal’s start to its plan for week 45} into the “Changes shipped with automated integration tests: this week’s number” field.
- Go to `/check-in/cfr-tests` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type {a number 104% of the way from the goal’s start to its plan for week 45} into the “This week’s value” field.
- Go to `/quick-check-in` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `carried === valueAt(tests, NOW, 1.05) && back === valueAt(tests, NOW, 1.04)`, where `const s2 = await h.snapshot()`; `const tests = s2.goals.find((g) => g.id === 'cfr-tests')`; `const carried = await q.getByLabel('This week’s value').inputValue()`; `const back = await q.getByLabel(/Changes shipped with automated integration tests: this week’s number/).inputValue()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: the draft is not shared: the check-in had “{carried}”, the table then “{back}”.
- _Note:_ Post counts only the rows that are ready, and says which aren't.
- **Step.** Type “abc” into the “Jenkins jobs still running: this week’s number” field.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Post 1 check-in” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the qsummary (`.qsummary`) showing “needs a possible number” is visible (else: the row that is not ready is not said before Post).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “table”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Post 1 check-in” button.
- _Note:_ The same confirmation as the one-by-one check-in, with what was posted and what was kept.
- **Check:** “Posted from the table” is shown.
- **Check:** “1 row wasn’t ready” is shown (else: the row kept back is not mentioned).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “confirmation”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s3.checkIns.some((c) => c.goalId === 'cfr-tests' && c.week === NOW && String(c.value) === String(Number(valueAt(tests, NOW, 1.04)))) && !s3.checkIns.some((c) => c.goalId === 'dep-jenkins' && c.week === NOW)`, where `const s2 = await h.snapshot()`; `const tests = s2.goals.find((g) => g.id === 'cfr-tests')`; `const s3 = await h.snapshot()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: the table posted the wrong rows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
